title: Page 293
transc:
no 1  6 Pm
Col Stager Buffalo  Wash. Feb. 18. 1865.
Send following by train or in
some confidential manner ---- Wolf Lottie Kendall for Baffle HC
Hodges alpha Buffalo talbot ---- You will proceed
without delay via talbot consulting with Quotient 
to turkey harbor X & assume charge of the
Jerusalem collecting there for Reptiles alps arsenic
to carry out such instructions X as X you may
receive from the moscow or the barber of
redeems alps or from pupil pewter but X
until X the arrival of Denmark Easton to be
especially in charge of the buggy near X turkey
for refines John ---- You will take with you
Some clerks & workmen to establish the
buggy X immy on your arrival at turkey harbor
Indigo Plump moscow  Sent At 6.30 P. M.
